Platt scaling (original Platt 1999 target-smoothing, t+=(N+ +1)/(N+ +2), t-=1/(N- +2), fit via Nelder-Mead — see scripts/calibrate_injection_cascade.py::_fit_platt) on the injection sub-head's raw logit, fit on evals/sanitize/{overdefense,attacks}.jsonl (held-out, not training data). Plain MLE on hard 0/1 labels diverges on this perfectly-separable data (tried first, produced a near-step sigmoid and a nonsensical ~0.98-wide band); the smoothing keeps it well-behaved. band=[max calibrated benign score, min calibrated attack score] — the region with no direct held-out evidence either way. This score is used ONLY for injection_uncertain (band membership) — it never feeds the primary injection threshold decision, which stays on the raw sigmoid (thresholds.json's 0.45 was tuned and verified against that raw scale; see classifier.py::decode()). Inert unless config.injection_cascade_enabled=True (default False).
